meta.how_measured: temporary integration test calling the public API (Normalizer::normalize, processing::process_text, SeamStitcher::stitch) with the strings below; the probe was deleted afterwards, nothing else changed
meta.note: ZWNJ is U+200C, written here as \u200c so it is visible. `current` is what the code produced today; `expected` is what the roadmap says must hold; `verdict` is the gap between them.
meta.encoding: all strings are Persian unless stated

cases.note: a mis-split prefix must not be invented when the engine already spaced it
cases.expected: می روم (or می‌روم — the roadmap leaves this open; must be decided, not defaulted)

cases.note: hamza is deleted rather than mapped; information loss
cases.expected: UNDECIDED — roadmap has no rule for bare hamza

cases.note: punctuation attaches to the previous word, one space after
Arabic-Indic digits are mapped to Persian digits
ASCII digits are NOT touched — there is no number option in settings at all
cases.expected: UNDECIDED — roadmap §4.1 wants an independent number option

cases.note: dictionary correction on top of normalisation
cases.input: من با پاتون و لينوكس كار ميكنم
cases.current: من با پایتون و لینوکس کار می‌کنم
cases.expected: من با پایتون و لینوکس کار می‌کنم

cases.note: first chunk of a streamed session
cases.input: این یک آزمون است و ادامه دارد

cases.note: overlap tail repeated by the recogniser must be dropped
cases.input: و ادامه دارد تا پایان (chunk 2, after T0-015)

cases.note: a truncated word is kept as-is until the full word arrives; no backspace is invented

missing_capabilities: no raw / conservative / formal mode: process_text always normalises then corrects (processing/mod.rs:15)
no settings switch for the normaliser at all — [streaming] is the only text-related section (config/settings.rs:42)
no independent options for numbers, punctuation or ZWNJ (roadmap §4.1)
no punctuation/space policy at the injection boundary: inject_text types exactly the string it is given (output/injector.rs:23)
no target check: nothing between process_text and SendInput looks at which window is focused
